content.title: Trump: ‘Fight is Militarily Won’ in Iran; Chuck Norris Dies at 86 | NTD News Today (March 20)
content.text: President Trump on Friday touted victories from U.S. strikes on Iran to a win on the football field for the Navy. He also criticized NATO allies for their lack of willingness to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Chuck Norris, martial arts expert turned legendary Hollywood action star, has died at the age of 86. Norris died on Friday in Hawaii surrounded by loved ones, with news of his passing confirmed in a statement through his official Instagram account. 🔵Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed with NTD News.👉https://www.ntd.com/newsletter.htm?ut....
